answers.R1: To-do: 2 things, answer the Taiwan crisis (pick an option), then the proposed order (Address the nation, accept or not), then Review and execute. First press: Joint patrol with Japan, since it is marked as recommended and keeps the goal. Pass.
answers.R2: 6 things, 1 done. Execute: my patrol choice happens, ministers take 4 meetings with China -3 and Japan -2, 2 proposed orders do not run and 2 capital stay. Pass.
answers.R3: Press Choose on an option card. Skip: Foreign Minister says 'We note your concern', free, China relations -3. Pass, but I would want to know if -3 is permanent or decays.
answers.R4: Xi call went to the Foreign Minister, China -3, Undo available. Screen now asks about the 2 routine meetings: let ministers take both, or open one by one. Pass.
answers.R5: Click 'All 6', a dropdown list, then click row 5 Orders your advisors propose. Pass.
answers.R6: Execute does the 3 choices, the 2 accepted items, skips the intelligence order; I spend 1 of 3 capital, 2 carry over. Undo via Change or Undo on a row. Pass, though I could not see the full bottom of the card.
answers.R7: Answer Xi from the card on the left. Middle button '3 recommendations to check' opens the recommendations to review, does not approve. Pass.
answers.R8: Pressable: Choose, Skip this call, Next, Accept, Execute month, Change, Undo, All 6, Guided/Full desk. Not pressable: Approval/Stability numbers, the 'You chose' text, tension. Unsure: step chips 'Takaichi visits' and '+3 more' (jump or just status?), the star line 'Recommended by...', the '?' button, whether 'Mission details' is a button.
answers.R9: Yes, Full desk lets me go at my pace and see all 6 items and advisors at once; Accept all 3 recommendations is good. Still slowing: the 'Full desk is now your default' banner, and I would want order previews with numbers in one table, plus why-did-it-move detail.

would_turn_off: Step 1/Step 2/Step 3 labels competing with each other in one screen
Skip silently costing relations (-3) with no sense of how it decays
Routine meetings 'no effect' hidden behind ministers; I want to see them to verify fairness
Possible hand-holding if Guided stayed the default
clickable_confusions: Step chips: Takaichi visits, +3 more, 1 done (jump or status)
Mission details looks like a button, fine, but Mission line text itself unclear
Green check 'You chose' rows: is the check clickable (only Change is)

wording.Recommended vs Staff picks: 'Recommended by your Secretary of State' reads clearer: it names who and why, so I can weigh the source. 'Staff picks' sounds like a curated shelf with no accountability.

agenda.verbatim: Better than the usual wizard stuff: I can see the consequences of Execute before I press it, and I like that the skip cost is spelled out. But 'Step 1, Step 2, Step 3' in three places is noisy, and I still want Full desk. Also 'Recommended' that hurts my own goal (quiet pause, Japan -4) is odd but honest, good. Unknown words: 'routine meetings' (what exactly), 'political capital' is fine, 'Execute month' is fine.
